An open-source, offline-first alternative to Garmin Connect. Not affiliated with Garmin.
Read your watch with a USB cable or a folder, follow your heart rate live over Bluetooth, or pull your data from your Garmin account.
Read the watch with a USB cable

Plug the watch into the phone with its cable (USB-C, or with an OTG adapter). OpenConnect then copies the activities and the all-day data stored on the watch: steps, heart rate, stress, Body Battery, sleep, HRV and SpO2. It goes straight from the watch to this phone, not through Garmin or the internet.
No Garmin watch found on the USB port. Check the cable and that the watch is switched on, then search again.
%1$d file(s) read, %2$d skipped because they were read before
Activities: %1$d new, %2$d already in the app
The watch is no longer connected.
Android did not give OpenConnect access to the watch. Search again and allow it when asked.
The watch did not answer as a storage device. Unlock it, try another cable, or look for a USB or MTP mode in its settings.
The watch connected, but it has no GARMIN folder with data.

Shows your heart rate live from a Garmin watch that broadcasts it, or from a chest strap. On the watch, look for Sensors & accessories, Wrist heart rate, Broadcast heart rate (the names differ per model).
Bluetooth permission is needed to find sensors.

The watch itself talks Bluetooth only to Garmin\'s own app and to heart-rate receivers. Everything else it stores can be read from the cable or a folder, or comes from your Garmin account (see the Garmin screen).
Read a folder with watch files

Pick the GARMIN folder of the watch, a copy of it, or any folder with .fit files. Android\'s folder picker also lists a watch that is plugged in as a storage device. Files that were read before are skipped.
No .fit files were found in that folder.

Your watch talks to the Garmin Connect app on your phone over Bluetooth, and Garmin keeps your data in its cloud. OpenConnect reads your own data from there with a personal key that only you can create. There is no server of ours in between.
Make the key on Garmin\'s page (it is shown once), copy it and paste it below. OpenConnect keeps it encrypted on this phone and sends it only to Garmin.
Key saved, paste a new one to replace it
Asking Garmin whether the key works…
Garmin did not accept the key. It may be wrong, expired or deleted. Make a new one on Garmin\'s page and paste it here.
Garmin could not be reached, so the key has not been checked yet.
A key is saved. It is checked the first time you sync.
That does not look like a Garmin key. Copy the whole key from Garmin\'s page.
Secure storage is not available on this device, so the key cannot be saved.
Fetches your steps, heart rate, stress, Body Battery, sleep, HRV and activities. New data from the watch appears here after the watch has synced with the Garmin Connect app.

Garmin did not accept the key. Make a new one and paste it above.
No connection to Garmin. Check your internet connection and try again.
Garmin is limiting requests. Try again later.
Garmin had a problem on its side. Try again later.
The sync stopped early. What was fetched is saved.
Sync when the app opens (at most every 6 hours)
Copied. It holds names and counts only, no data and no key.
Garmin allows the personal key for your own data in tools you run yourself. Do not share it and do not put it in other people\'s apps.
